text:
alex_chen: Heads up — after the connector restart last night, ~12 inbound EMEA leads were routed to the wrong owner (US SDR queue). Anyone else seeing this?

maria_g: Yep, noticed a spike in assignment errors around 03:12 UTC. HubSpot payloads missing geo_country on a subset.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: connector-service v2.14 rolled at 2026-03-23T03:10:59Z :white_check_mark:

samir: My guess is round-robin fallback when shard key (geo) is null -> defaults to US pool. We saw this pattern in Feb.

tyler_sales: I got 4 EMEA leads in my queue this morning. No timezone tag, created_at 03:11-03:13 UTC.

lia_marketing: Oof — those were webinar follow-ups. Some prospects got delayed responses. Not great for conversion. :grimacing:

devops_jen: Looking at k8s events now. There was a configmap reload during the rollout, might be a brief window where metadata enrichment worker returned empty.

devops_jen: log snippet:```
2026-03-23T03:11:42Z INFO  connector  incoming lead id=12983 geo=null owner_pool=us-sdr
2026-03-23T03:11:43Z WARN  assigner   roundrobin fallback -> pool=default
2026-03-23T03:11:44Z ERROR enrichment timeout id=12984 rc=504
```

samir: Short-term mitigation: run ad-hoc enrichment/backfill for leads created between 03:05-03:20 UTC and re-run assignment. Long-term: validate geo before applying round-robin and fallback to geo-enrichment queue rather than default US pool.

alex_chen: Can we get a backfill command? Also need to notify SDRs for leads reassigned.

devops_jen: Backfill command (dry-run first):
```bash
./tools/lead_backfill --from "2026-03-23T03:05:00Z" --to "2026-03-23T03:20:00Z" --stage enrichment --dry-run
```
Then remove --dry-run to apply.

maria_g: HubSpot rule check: some workflows rely on `{{lead.geo_country}}` being present. We should add a guard to the workflow: `if empty({{lead.geo_country}}) -> send to enrichment`, not assign.

samir: Also update SF mapping: don't push owner to Salesforce until lead has validated owner. Otherwise SF ends up with US owner and triggers incorrect territory workflows.

tyler_sales: If we reassign leads, please ping me before changing ownership for leads that already had sequences started.

lia_marketing: I'll draft a quick customer-facing note in case any webinar registrants were affected.

alex_chen: Action items:
- jen: run backfill dry-run now, then apply if results look good (ETA 20m)
- dev: add guard to assigner to check geo before fallback (hotfix patch)
- ops: add canary for connector rollout to catch configmap reload edge cases
- marketing: prepare registrant note if >10 affected
- sales: hold on sequence changes until notified

devops_jen: Dry-run finished, 12 leads flagged for reassign, looks correct. Applying now.

ops-bot: Job finished: lead_backfill applied 12 leads at 2026-03-23T03:42:07Z

devops_jen: Hotfix merged to check `lead.geo_country` before fallback. Added metric `assigner.geo_missing.count`. Will roll to prod as canary.

samir: Nice, also add a small circuit-breaker: if enrichmentTimeouts > 5% for last 5m, requeue instead of default assign.

alex_chen: Thanks all — monitoring for 24h. Lia will draft comms. Tyler, please confirm when safe to resume sequences for those 12 leads.

tyler_sales: Confirmed, sequences paused. I'll resume after final owner check.

lia_marketing: Draft ready, will post if we see further anomalies.

alex_chen: Closing loop: remediation done, telemetry added, playbook updated (inbound-routing-runbook). Will follow up with a short retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
